exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to gather, to collect, to harvest
to dismantle, to disassemble, to take apart, to deconstruct
to choose, to select, to pick, to pick out
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: собира́ть — to gather, to collect, to harvest; разобра́ть — to dismantle, to disassemble, to take apart, to deconstruct; выбира́ть — to choose, to select, to pick, to pick out; добра́ться — to get (to), to reach.
**изберут** — избра́ть (perfective): to choose, to elect. Wiktionary: из- + брать.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: убра́ть — to remove, to take away; вы́бор — choice (option or decision); забра́ть — to take away, to seize, to collect; to capture, to take possession; бра́ться — to take something with hands, to take (mutually, together) (e.g. each other's hands).
